Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for a mobile 2D top-down Western fantasy action RPG. Reference image is the character identity reference, the holy knight with blond hair, silver/gold armor, blue cape, sword and shield. Create an animation sheet of this SAME knight, not a portrait. Output a square canvas, exact uniform grid of 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS = 16 separate full-body frames on real transparent alpha. Each frame occupies its own equal square cell, exact same character scale, aligned feet baseline, fixed camera and centered root position. Generous 15% empty padding inside EVERY cell, nothing crosses cell borders. Camera: orthographic three-quarter game view, character facing right and slightly toward bottom of screen. Style matches reference: polished chibi, very large head, short body, crisp dark outlines, simplified cel shading readable when each frame is reduced to 128x128 pixels. ROW 1: 4 frames idle breathing, subtle cloak movement. ROW 2: 4 distinct frames of RUNNING, left-leg forward, passing feet, right-leg forward, passing feet, arms and cloak counter-swing. ROW 3: 4 distinct ATTACK frames, sword raised windup, sword sweeping forward, slash follow-through, return to ready. ROW 4: 4 distinct HURT frames, initial recoil, backward flinch, recovery, ready again. All limbs and sword MUST be fully visible in every cell. No perspective changes, no change of costume, no duplicates masquerading as animation, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no shadows behind character, no backdrop. Transparent alpha must separate every frame. Intended source resolution 1024x1024; game imports it as 512x512, with 128x128 cells.
